prompt: The client wants to know how serious a new rival is. Which takeaway matters most?

options.text: The client kept the larger share in 2025, by 8 points
options.feedback: True, but the trend matters more: the gap shrank from 30 points to 8 in three years.

options.text: The client's share has been stable
The rival is winning on price
options.feedback: The chart shows share, not prices. That may be true, but nothing here supports it.

options.text: The rival gained 13 points as the client lost 9
options.feedback: Right. The rival went from 10% to 23%; the client from 40% to 31%.
